# AgentOps instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before creating, editing, or reviewing files under `agentops/`, read and follow:

- [`agentops/AGENTS.md`](../../agentops/AGENTS.md)

`agentops/AGENTS.md` is the canonical source of AgentOps contribution rules.

Do not duplicate those rules in this file. If the files diverge, follow
`agentops/AGENTS.md`.
